# Jotform
> Jotform is a no-code platform for building online forms, collecting data, automating workflows, generating documents, and accepting payments.

Jotform combines a drag-and-drop form builder with products for approvals, e-signatures, reports, tables, apps, workflows, and AI agents. Its platform also includes large template libraries, payment integrations, and resources for developers and teams.

## Core Platform
- [Free Online Form Builder & Form Creator for 2026 | Jotform](https://www.jotform.com/): Drag-and-drop form builder for surveys, registrations, applications, orders, and payments.
- [Jotform Enterprise](https://www.jotform.com/enterprise/): Enterprise-grade forms and workflow platform with security, governance, and admin controls.
- [Jotform Mobile Forms](https://www.jotform.com/mobile-forms/): Build and collect forms on mobile devices with offline submission support.
- [Jotform Teams](https://www.jotform.com/teams/): Collaboration features for shared workspaces, permissions, and team form management.
- [Jotform HIPAA Forms](https://www.jotform.com/hipaa/): HIPAA-ready forms and data collection tools for healthcare organizations.
- [Jotform for Salesforce](https://www.jotform.com/salesforce/): Connect forms with Salesforce to sync submissions and streamline CRM workflows.

## Products
- [Jotform Apps](https://www.jotform.com/products/apps/): No-code app builder for turning forms and data into branded mobile-style apps.
- [Jotform Tables](https://www.jotform.com/products/tables/): Spreadsheet-database hybrid for organizing submissions, workflows, and team data.
- [Jotform Sign](https://www.jotform.com/products/sign/): E-signature workflows for contracts, approvals, and document signing.
- [Jotform Approvals](https://www.jotform.com/products/approvals/): Approval flows for requests, reviews, and multi-step decision processes.
- [Jotform Report Builder](https://www.jotform.com/products/report-builder/): Create visual reports from form submissions with charts and summaries.
- [Jotform Inbox](https://www.jotform.com/products/inbox/): Shared communication workspace for managing conversations around submissions.
- [Jotform Workflows](https://www.jotform.com/products/workflows/): Automate business processes with no-code workflow builders and routing logic.
- [Jotform AI Agents](https://www.jotform.com/products/ai-agents/): Build AI-powered agents for support, lead capture, and automated interactions.

## Templates
- [Form Templates](https://www.jotform.com/form-templates/): Large library of ready-made templates for forms, surveys, and business workflows.
- [App Templates](https://www.jotform.com/app-templates/): Prebuilt app templates for directories, portals, scheduling, and internal tools.
- [Table Templates](https://www.jotform.com/table-templates/): Templates for CRM, project tracking, budgets, inventory, and operations.
- [Workflow Templates](https://www.jotform.com/workflow-templates/): Reusable workflow templates for approvals, onboarding, and recurring processes.
- [PDF Templates](https://www.jotform.com/pdf-templates/): Fillable PDF templates for documents, applications, invoices, and records.
- [Agent Templates](https://www.jotform.com/agent-templates/): AI agent examples for customer service, intake, and information retrieval.
- [Board Templates](https://www.jotform.com/board-templates/): Kanban-style board templates for planning, tracking, and collaboration.
- [Sign Templates](https://www.jotform.com/pdf-templates/e-sign): E-sign document templates for agreements, waivers, and approvals.

## Features
- [Online Forms](https://www.jotform.com/online-forms/): Overview of online form creation, sharing, and submission collection.
- [Survey Maker](https://www.jotform.com/survey-maker/): Build surveys with customizable question types, logic, and reporting.
- [Quiz Maker](https://www.jotform.com/quiz-maker/): Create quizzes and assessments with scoring and conditional logic.
- [Fillable PDF Form Creator](https://www.jotform.com/fillable-pdf-form-creator/): Convert documents into fillable PDF forms for digital completion.
- [Card Form](https://www.jotform.com/card-forms/): Conversational card-style forms designed for improved completion rates.
- [Conditional Logic Forms](https://www.jotform.com/conditional-logic-forms/): Add dynamic behavior and branching based on user responses.
- [Form Analytics](https://www.jotform.com/form-analytics/): Track form performance, abandonment, and submission behavior.
- [Form Calculations](https://www.jotform.com/form-calculations/): Use calculations for pricing, scoring, totals, and custom formulas.

## Payments
- [Payment Forms](https://www.jotform.com/payment-forms/): Create forms for collecting payments, donations, fees, and orders.
- [Jotform Store Builder](https://www.jotform.com/store-builder/): Build simple online stores with product listings and payment collection.
- [PayPal Integration](https://www.jotform.com/integrations/paypal): Accept payments through PayPal in Jotform forms.
- [Stripe Integration](https://www.jotform.com/integrations/stripe): Connect Stripe to process card payments and online transactions.
- [Square Integration](https://www.jotform.com/integrations/square): Use Square for payments and commerce workflows in forms.
- [Authorize.net Integration](https://www.jotform.com/integrations/authorize-net): Process secure online payments with Authorize.net.
- [Payment Integrations](https://www.jotform.com/payment-integrations/): Directory of payment gateways and processors supported by Jotform.

## Integrations
- [Integrations](https://www.jotform.com/integrations/): Browse integrations for payments, CRM, storage, communication, and automation.
- [Google Sheets Integration](https://www.jotform.com/integrations/google-sheets): Send form submissions directly to Google Sheets.
- [Slack Integration](https://www.jotform.com/integrations/slack): Post notifications and automate team communication from submissions.
- [Microsoft Teams Integration](https://www.jotform.com/integrations/microsoft-teams): Connect forms with Teams for alerts and collaboration workflows.
- [Salesforce Integration](https://www.jotform.com/integrations/salesforce): Sync form data with Salesforce records and processes.
- [HubSpot Integration](https://www.jotform.com/integrations/hubspot): Send leads and submission data into HubSpot.
- [Zapier Integration](https://www.jotform.com/integrations/zapier): Connect Jotform to thousands of apps through Zapier automation.
- [Dropbox Integration](https://www.jotform.com/integrations/dropbox): Store uploaded files and submission assets in Dropbox.

## Solutions by Use Case
- [Registration Forms](https://www.jotform.com/online-registration-form/): Create registration workflows for events, classes, and programs.
- [Application Forms](https://www.jotform.com/application-forms/): Build application forms for jobs, schools, grants, and programs.
- [Order Forms](https://www.jotform.com/order-forms/): Collect product orders, service requests, and payments online.
- [Contact Forms](https://www.jotform.com/contact-forms/): Publish contact forms for inquiries, support, and lead capture.
- [Feedback Forms](https://www.jotform.com/feedback-forms/): Gather customer, employee, and event feedback with customizable forms.
- [Donation Forms](https://www.jotform.com/donation-forms/): Accept donations and recurring contributions through online forms.
- [Appointment Forms](https://www.jotform.com/appointment-forms/): Manage bookings, scheduling, and service requests with form-based intake.
- [HIPAA Compliance](https://www.jotform.com/hipaa/): Secure healthcare data collection and compliant form workflows.
